description: This file defines the OutputStyle class within the SCSSPHP library, providing constants and methods to handle different output styles ('expanded' and 'compressed') for SCSS compilation, along with utility methods to convert between strings and class constants.

classes.name: OutputStyle
classes.description: Final class providing constants and static methods to handle SCSS output styles, supporting conversion between string representations and internal constants.

methods.name: fromString
methods.description: Converts a string ('expanded' or 'compressed') into the corresponding OutputStyle constant, supporting different library versions.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Converts an OutputStyle constant back into its string representation compatible with various versions.
